---
name: A site doesn't switch
about: Hatswap saved the account but switching doesn't land on it, or lands on the wrong one.
title: "[site] "
labels: site-support
---

**Site** (the domain, e.g. `publish.buffer.com`):

**What happened after the switch?** (just reloaded / signed out / wrong account / login page / something else)

**What did the Hatswap popup say?** (copy the message or the warnings list if there was one)

**Did the toolbar badge show `!` or `?` afterwards?**

**Chrome version** (`chrome://version`) and **Hatswap version** (Settings, bottom):

**Anything else?** (e.g. the site uses two-factor login, you were signed in by hand, several tabs of the site were open)
